scope: M6 cold-state deferral and same-provider borrow; independent resolution protocol after the previous frozen batch
work: N=K/H0 history roots plus one exact old View; independent 64x64 B4 replicas; Preserve complete new input; begin transaction through mutation/full memset/seal/canonical commit
sample_lifecycle: Every sample independently initializes its required one or two exact replicas, validates all old/current bytes and actual copy/payload/budget work, releases blockers, closes the Store, destroys its metadata and drains reclamation. No artificial alternate is added between generations of a live sample
outside_timer: Setup, before creation, byte/work/budget verification, completion, close/Store destruction and drain; summarized separately. All measured operation durations retained, first/last budgets and observed class peaks reported

window.stopping: Predetermined cumulative operation wall budget AND minimum work count; never extend after looking at statistics

parent_comparison.metric: actual current/parent completed-operation throughput; median of20 predeclared balanced two-pair log blocks
parent_comparison.gate: lower>1 confirms improvement; hit is an affected control, not required to show significant positive increment
parent_comparison.order: Separate original product images, reverse order each pair and rotate all eight buckets; each process meets the same predetermined timing window

calibration.metric: normal-on selection/original current completed-operation throughput; median20 balanced two-pair log blocks
calibration.order: Separate processes, original product vs selection image with normal handoff; reverse order each pair, rotate20 buckets
calibration.meaning: 20-bucket family nominal95% equivalence; same-source switch/library effects remain a separate qualification. No subtraction or borrowed per-bucket calibration

hit.metric: median40 independent process-pair log(off/on median operation latency)
hit.order: Each independent process runs both separately initialized arms; alternate off/on order for every sample pair and starting order for every process pair

miss.metric: on/off actual completed-operation throughput in one independent paired process; median20 predeclared balanced two-process log blocks
miss.order: Alternate sample arm order within each independent process, same complete lifecycle and equal completed counts; rotate16 buckets and reverse initial arm order across processes
miss.independent_unit: Process containing both arms, then predeclared adjacent order blocks; individual inner samples never treated as independent repeats

protected: Original fixed-M5 same-dependency public Fresh/H4 fixtures,40 pairs/four buckets per family,250ms completed-rate/20 order blocks,50000 bootstrap seed260926,one-sided98.75% lower>=0.98; new samples, no fixture change
preflight: Same finite90 two-sample semantic/capacity/generation fixture processes plus2 selection-image targeted QTest processes; add12 fixed/paired 1ms window protocol smoke processes covering both architectures and switches; diagnostic times excluded
mechanism: 40 two-sample diagnostic image processes, parent/current×two architectures×K1/K16×five shapes; copied one-TU call-site counters only. Expect [before ledger lookup,cold Prepared construction]: hit parent[K,K] current[0,K], native pin parent[K,K] current[0,0], other shapes[0,0]. Original phase observer also checks unchanged success/fallback responsibilities. No diagnostic image used for time qualification
images: Original parent dylib copied before changes; current product unmodified measurement image; selection copy changes only TLS discovery switch; separate mechanism parent/current copies add only private counters in the one coordinator TU. Actual image paths and all input hashes checked
stopping: Exactly40 process pairs/bucket; no trimming, replacement, optional sampling or threshold changes. Wrong bytes/work/image, timeout, abnormal exit or input change stops the affected scope and retains all data; statistics never stops or extends scopes
execution: All performance processes sequential, no build/test/profiler/analysis overlap. No stage clocks or enabled mechanism recorder; bounded output per process and final scope consolidation
qualification: Each family independent, nominal95% at prescribed corrections. Parent/current production increment independent of selection calibration. Same-image results need applicable calibration for product qualification. Metadata comparable residency>=25%, CP0 full required, natural business producer/distribution, M7/M8/GPU and default strategy stay separate
